meta.name: reactorkit design brief parameters
meta.confidence_legend_str: high = read in source or exact algebra; medium = consistent across secondary sources or reproduced by independent calculation; unverified = memory or own estimate; derived = calculated here from listed inputs (scripts in scratchpad/brief)

geometry.bottom_shape_str: flat in CFD (real vessel torispherical; volume difference ignored)
geometry.feed_inlet_location_str: lid patch at the liquid surface (ring source in SRF; point nozzle in lab-frame transient run)

impeller.pumping_sense_str: down along the wall, up along the shaft

operating_point.mode_default_str: B: prescribed inner-wall temperature + level control; feed rate is an output
operating_point.mode_check_str: A: prescribed feed 110 kg/h + level; required wall temperature is an output

F5_raw_BR_household_do_not_feed.role_str: guard demonstration only, not simulated in CFD

rheology.model_str: eta = eta_floor + eta0(T,Mw)/[1 + (eta0*gamma_dot/tau_star)^(1-n)]; eta0 = max(K*Mw^alpha, eta_wax(Mw))*aT(T)
rheology.blend_rule_str: ln eta0_mix = sum_i w_i ln eta0_i(Mw_i)

kinetics.scheme_str: RS-L2 apparent (TGA, validation and 0-D) + psi/class closure (CFD liquid phase)

wall_heat_transfer.default_bc_str: prescribed inner-wall temperature via diffuse Robin source with wall-function h

turbulence.model_str: k-omega SST (Menter 2003) + rotation-curvature correction; laminar where nu_t<<nu

bubbles.model_str: drift-flux vapour volume fraction, vertical slip

free_surface.model_str: rigid free-slip lid; optional reshaped lid from p_lid

numerics.frame_str: whole-domain single rotating reference frame (SRF), steady; lab-frame moving mask for verification/video
numerics.grid_type_str: uniform Cartesian MAC, cubic box side 0.8 m + 4 cells
numerics.poisson_str: fast diagonalisation (flarekit), all-Neumann, zero mode removed, TF32 off

sources.concept: Research synthesis: Plastic Energy, Quantafuel (flue-gas heated vessel), Pryme (extruder melt feed), Japanese municipal plants (Juji Lin, Columbia/WTERT thesis) - medium; decision matrix - author judgement
sources.geometry, impeller, operating_point: this work (design calculation; capacity curves from 0-D model in scratchpad/brief/final.py) - derived
sources.feeds.F3_BR_MPO: Matos T.F.L., MSc EESC-USP 2006 (Sao Carlos), renormalised - high (split) / medium (ash)
sources.feeds.HHV_literature_MJ_per_kg: handbook consensus; Boie check within 1-6% - medium
sources.feeds.guard_limits_wt_pct: Alliance to End Plastic Waste & Eunomia, Feedstock Quality Guidelines for Pyrolysis, 2022 (secondary summary; categories sum > total) - medium
sources.feeds.steam_cracker_limits_ppm: Kusenberg M. et al., Waste Management 138 (2022) 83-115 - medium
sources.properties.rho_*: Zoller & Walsh 1995 / Olabisi-Simha Tait fits (unverified); checked vs ISO 1133 densities to 0.15% - medium
sources.properties.k_*: Moldflow-type data; DTIC AD0489089 trend - unverified
sources.properties.Riazi_Tb_coeffs: Riazi M.R., ASTM MNL50 (2005); reproduces n-alkane Tb C5-C30 within 0.5 K - medium
sources.properties.vapour_*: ideal gas; Poling, Prausnitz & O'Connell 2001 correlations - unverified; M from closure - derived
sources.rheology.PE: Raju V.R. et al., J. Polym. Sci. Polym. Phys. 17 (1979) 1183 (unverified prefactor; consistent with ISO 1133 MFI check and Dow patent fits within 2.3x) ; Ea: US 6,121,402 - medium
sources.rheology.PE_wax_branch: NuCera/Chase POLYWAX datasheet (7/15/55/130 mPa s at 149 C) - medium; slope 1.9 fitted by verifier
sources.rheology.PP: US patent on high-purity PP (US 11,208,510 or 7,019,044) - medium (Tref inferred 230 C); Ea: Nihon Reoroji Gakkaishi 17(1) - medium
sources.rheology.expected_bulk_viscosity: steady chain-length population balance + closure (this work and verifier cstr_pb.py) - derived, medium-low
sources.kinetics.E: Aboulkas A., El harfi K., El Bouadili A., Energy Convers. Manage. 51 (2010) 1363-1369, doi 10.1016/j.enconman.2009.12.017 - medium-high
sources.kinetics.A: calibrated here to consensus Tpeak at 10 K/min (calibration, not literature) - derived
sources.kinetics.Tpeak_targets: consensus band; cross-checked by Westerhout et al., Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 36 (1997) 1955, doi 10.1021/ie960501m and Alhulaybi & Dubdub, Polymers 15 (2023) 3010, doi 10.3390/polym15143010 - medium
sources.kinetics.kc_factor: L=20 C2 cut mapping (verifier, max |dalpha| 0.009-0.018); PP factor 0.053 calibrated here to Tpeak 455 C - derived
sources.kinetics.RS_theory: Sanchez-Jimenez P.E. et al., J. Phys. Chem. A 114 (2010) 7868 - high (algebra re-derived)
sources.kinetics.PET: Alhulaybi Z., Dubdub I., Polymers 15 (2023) 3010 - medium-high; char 0.15 unverified
sources.kinetics.mixture_interaction: Li Y. et al. (synergy PS/PE) and Williams & Williams, Energy Fuels 13 (1999) 188 - medium (direction); gamma derived
sources.kinetics.secondary_cracking: engineering estimate; FAILS Mastral 2002 and Elordi 2011 above 600 C; keep disabled - unreliable above 550 C
sources.products.gas_channel: calibration knob to Kitaoka-Murata 1971 (~4% gas, 440 C, J. Fuel Soc. Japan 50(10)) and Onwudili et al., JAAP 86 (2009) 293 (10% gas LDPE 425 C, closed autoclave) - unverified
sources.products.oil_wax_split: random-scission fragment rule with N*(T) (this work) - derived
sources.energy.dH_gasification: Stoliarov S.I., Walters R.N., Polym. Degrad. Stab. 93 (2008) 422-427 / FAA DOT/FAA/AR-TN07/62 (open-pan DSC; table sums checked) - medium
sources.energy.dH_band: Frederick & Mentzer 1975 (630-820 J/g) and Khedri S., Lakehead MSc 2017 (1375 +/- 233 kJ/kg) - medium
sources.energy.scission_enthalpy: NIST WebBook heats of formation + Benson group additivity (+83.1 / +82.4 kJ/mol) - medium
sources.wall_heat_transfer.nagata_ribbon: Nagata et al., as cited in J. Heat Mass Transfer Res. 7 (2020) 1-10 (Semnan) - medium
sources.wall_heat_transfer.uhl: Uhl & Gray (eds), Mixing vol. 1 (1966) via CheCalc calculator - medium (0.36 branch) / unverified (1.0 Re^0.5 branch)
sources.wall_heat_transfer.kader: Kader B.A., IJHMT 24 (1981) 1541; Spalding, J. Appl. Mech. 28 (1961) 455 - medium (formulas from memory, cross-checked)
sources.turbulence: Menter, Kuntz & Langtry 2003; Smirnov & Menter, J. Turbomach. 131 (2009) 041010 - medium
sources.numerics.rkl2: Meyer, Balsara & Aslam, J. Comput. Phys. 257 (2014) 594 - medium
sources.numerics.brinkman: Angot, Bruneau & Fabrie, Numer. Math. 81 (1999) 497, doi 10.1007/s002110050401 - high
sources.numerics.gci: Celik et al., J. Fluids Eng. 130 (2008) 078001, doi 10.1115/1.2960953 - high
sources.numerics.psitc: Mulder & van Leer 1985; van der Vorst 1992 - medium
sources.validation_targets.kp_ribbon_laminar: Patterson-Carreau-Yap-type correlation Kp = 82.8 (h/d)(c/d)^-0.38 (p/d)^-0.35 (w/d)^0.20 nb^0.78 - constants unverified; Delaplace et al., Chem. Eng. Sci. 2006, doi 10.1016/j.ces.2005.11.069 (framework) - medium
sources.validation_targets.ks_ribbon: Ayazi Shamlou P., Edwards M.F., Chem. Eng. Sci. 40 (1985) 1773, doi 10.1016/0009-2509(85)80040-3 - medium
sources.validation_targets.rushton_pbt: Handbook of Industrial Mixing (2004) ch. 6; Chapple et al., Trans IChemE 80A (2002) 364 - medium
sources.validation_targets.westerhout: Westerhout et al. 1997 (values via secondary review; integration verified) - medium
sources.validation_targets.murata: Murata K. et al., JAAP 65 (2002) 71-90 and JAAP 71 (2004) 569-589 - numbers unverified (search summaries)
sources.validation_targets.kitaoka_murata: Kitaoka & Murata, J. Fuel Soc. Japan 50(10) (1971) (J-STAGE abstract) - medium
sources.validation_targets.ghia_dvd: Ghia, Ghia & Shin, J. Comput. Phys. 48 (1982) 387; de Vahl Davis, IJNMF 3 (1983) 249 - medium (standard tables, from memory)
